reproduce_first.note: This was a feature request, not a bug fix.

assumptions_recorded.note: The ask specified the overdue rule and the requested label, filter, and count.

stack_discovery.note: The agent inspected package scripts and the README before running checks.

incremental_slices.note: The agent made layout fixes and reran end-to-end checks as it went, though the initial feature implementation was written together.

self_review.note: The done summary reports a review of correctness, readability, architecture, security, and performance before reporting completion.

simplification_pass.note: No behavior-preserving cleanup after passing checks followed by another check run is shown.

test_experiment.note: The agent intentionally changed overdue conditions and saw the unit tests fail.

docs_where_behavior_changed.note: The done summary says the README was updated for the behavior change.

scope_kept.note: The agent listed unrelated issues and follow-ups as noticed but untouched.

verification_story.note: The done summary lists checks and results, plus the manual Chrome check and screenshots.

hand_check.note: The agent checked the running app in Chrome and reviewed screenshots of the All and Overdue views.
